text:
deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary deploy started for release v2.14.3 on canary-group-a
supply-chain-scan: FAIL - HIGH severity vuln found in base image layer
Scan summary: 1 HIGH (CVE-2025-1234), 3 MEDIUM
Policy: FAIL if HIGH >= 1 -> deployment paused automatically :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Report: https://scans.internal/reports/1795559876

maria-rls: saw the deploy-bot alert — canary is paused. who can pick this up?

luke-sre: I'm on it. quick lookup shows CVE-2025-1234 affecting libc6 in base image 'ubuntu:22.04-slim@sha256:abcd1234...'

sam-qa: any functional failures observed in canary or just the scanner?

jitendra-release: smoke/perf tests look fine from my side. this is a supply-chain policy flag. options:
  - pin base image to a patched digest (if one exists)
  - rollback to previous release
  - get formal risk acceptance from Security/Legal to continue

legal-jane: need CVSS vector + exploitability notes. if there's a working exploit, we can't proceed without signoff. @luke-sre can you confirm exploit details?

luke-sre: running quick triage now. snippet to re-check image digest:
```
docker inspect ubuntu:22.04-slim@sha256:abcd1234 | jq '.RepoDigests'
```
No patched digest found in our private registry yet. Searching upstream for CVE patch...

maria-rls: change window closes in ~1h30m. if we wait for an upstream patch we might miss the window and delay rollout to customers.

michelle-product: from product POV: prefer pin-to-digest strategy if it reduces risk and keeps the window. otherwise we need a clear mitigation + follow-up plan.

alex-eng: hotpatching libc in-image is risky. not feasible quickly. pin or rollback are the realistic options.

jitendra-release: proposal: hold rollout 30m while SRE does triage. if no patched digest or security signoff within that time, escalate to exec for emergency exception OR pin to last-known-good digest and continue canary. @legal-jane @michelle-product

luke-sre: creating incident INC-2025-0427 for triage and timeline. I'll post updates in ~15m. :wrench:

deploy-bot: [incident-bot] Incident INC-2025-0427 created (priority: P2) - assigned to luke-sre

legal-jane: will try to expedite review but need SRE summary (exploitability, attack vector) before I can sign off. if exec approval required, pls tag #exec-approvals.

sam-qa: adding quick failing logs from canary run: `ERROR: segfault in native-ext at startup` — doesn't look directly related to libc CVE but worth noting.

maria-rls: noted. if SRE can't find a patched digest in 30m, I recommend pinning to our last-known-good digest `gcr.redwood/internal-images/ubuntu:22.04-slim@sha256:ef01...` and proceed with canary, then schedule a private follow-up deploy to replace the base image once a patch is confirmed.

jitendra-release: decision (temp): hold for 35m for triage. If no patched digest and no security signoff, pin to last-known-good digest and continue canary. @alex-eng please prepare a release notes blurb and a follow-up ticket for the full patch rollout. :thumbsup:

luke-sre: ACK. attempting to find patched digest now; if not available will prepare image pin PR and update INC-2025-0427.

maria-rls: I'll update the release notes and changelog accordingly and notify support. tagging @michelle-product for wording.

michelle-product: I'll draft short wording: "Temporarily pinned base image for release v2.14.3 due to a security scan finding; follow-up patch planned. No customer-facing functional changes."

jitendra-release: thanks all — we'll reconvene in #eng-releases when there's an update or at +35m. if anyone gets new info sooner, drop it here.
